text:
Sam: noticed circular wait in staging between prefetch workers and eviction sweeps under rapid demote. minimal stack pasted.
Alisha: drop the trace pls
Sam: gist: ```prefetch.lock(shard)
evict.lock(tenant)
evict.wait(prefetch_release)
prefetch.wait(evict_quiesce) // cycle```
Ben: sounds like inverted lock order (shard vs tenant). do we have canonical lock hierarchy?
Chen: not formalized. options: (1) flip prefetch to tenant->shard, (2) eviction uses non-blocking steal RPC to prefetch, (3) use shared-read tenant lock for prefetch and exclusive for eviction.
Maria: flip ordering is simplest correctness but may increase tail latency for hot micro-requests.
Alisha: steal RPC looks promising operationallyeviction calls `StealPrefix(tenant,prefix)`; prefetch yields metadata or requeues. need idempotency and clear retries.
Ben: agree. steal avoids global lock changes but adds RPC surface and subtle failure modes. I'll draft proto + failure scenarios.
Kai: will bench three variants: lock-flip, steal-RPC, read-mode-lock. test hotset (10k keys, zipf=.9), prefetch conc 1..8, demote intervals 2/10/30s. collect 95/99/99.9 + stall count.
Chen: on read-mode-lock we need safe upgrade; will prototype try_lock upgrade loop with randomized backoff to avoid upgrade deadlocks.
Sam: short-term mitigation: bounded-wait in eviction loop: if eviction can't acquire token within X ms, requeue and backoff. lowers stall risk during rollout. pair with tighter eviction budget to avoid OOM.
Maria: add telemetry: sample "lock_wait_chain" when goroutine blocks >5ms (record held locks + waiter). alert if cycles observed in staging.
Alisha: I'll add telemetry PR + a staging canary (fail if stall_rate >0.1% over 30m). also add lint note: `// non-blocking handoff required` for prefix handoff paths.
evict-bot: created INF-2345 (prefetch-evict deadlock) and INF-2346 (telemetry lock_wait_chain)
Ben: proto sketch: ```rpc StealPrefix(tenant, prefix, req_id) returns {status, holder_gen, metadata} // handoff must be idempotent```
Chen: tests: multi-reader upgrade attempt, ensure one backs off and progress continues.
Kai: starting runs now, will post CSV and perf summary in thread ~3h.
Sam: recap: 1) Kai perf matrix, 2) Ben proto + failure doc, 3) Chen try-upgrade prototype, 4) Alisha telemetry + canary, 5) bounded-wait patch. reconvene tomorrow.
Maria: +1, include affected tenant IDs in telemetry for repro.
Sam: will draft short postmortem after we have bench + telemetry.
